criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: No frame passes the showstopper test. Ground plane ends in a flat blue band on 1, 3, 4, 8, 9; no amber seam; hero reads navy not white; frame 3 seat a capsule and a stray rod; frame 5 fog hides most of the 200 places; frame 6 slab seat and misplaced gold tick with row 2 box empty; frame 8 ground seam and busy doors behind type; frame 9 procedural skyline, low-poly Texan, no rail. Frame 7 is a real detail render, frame 1 has contact and trees, frame 4 countable with consistent casts.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One blue hour world, one truck, one grade, a legible camera move. Frame 2 flat cartography outside the world, interiors 3, 6, 7 share no material with exteriors, empty seat motif asserted more than seen.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Frame 6 dek drops 'commercially'; frame 6 art shows one box empty; frame 8 picture illustrates the review clock not the threshold. No fabrication.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear what, who, where and what to do. The September 25th lane announcement is on no slide; frame 5 adds little to the state story.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 3 answers it, the turn at 6 and 7, 9 closes on an action. 4 and 5 make the same point; 2 is context.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain good hooks and specific Texas nouns. Frame 5's sourcing sentence, frame 9's 36 word run on, the caption's line about the artefact.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New subject, but count grids repeat no. 33's pad move, a vehicle hero mirrors no. 33, ground hex near no. 33's.
